links.outcome: Readability (Kincaid grade level, jargon score) of LLM patient education answers before and after fine-tuning
links.effect: Pre-existing LLMs had difficult readability (Kincaid 8.54, Jargon 4.44). After fine-tuning, CARDIO scored Kincaid 7.17 and Jargon 2.92, with readability rating 4.98.
links.quote: Pre-existing large language models (LLMs) demonstrated poor n-gram agreement, dissonance from model answers (accuracy 4.16, readability 4.63, and professionalism 4.58), and difficult readability (Kincaid 8.54 and Jargon 4.44).

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning an LLM with low-rank adaptation and reinforcement learning on curated authoritative sources
Iterative benchmarking of candidate LLMs with n-gram metrics and expert qualitative evaluation
Interdisciplinary team development of a domain-specific patient education LLM

screen.reason: The paper outlines the development, prompt tuning, and fine-tuning pipeline of a specialized LLM (CARDIO) for cardiovascular education in HIV care, evaluated via benchmarking and expert scoring without testing a health system deployment practice.
